messages.content: mero naam sarita ho, ma butwal ma baschhu.
namaste sarita! butwal ta ramro thau ho. aaja k ma sahayog garu?
ma kaha baschhu bhaneko thiye?
tapai butwal ma basnuhunchha bhannubhayo.
ma pokhara ma baschhu.
pokhara! phewa tal ra machhapuchhre najik, ramro thau.
haina, galti bhayo, ma ta chitwan ma baschhu.
thik chha, sachyaeko: tapai chitwan ma basnuhunchha.
aba bhana, ma kaha baschhu?
tapai chitwan ma basnuhunchha.
mero bhai 12 barsha ko chha ra didi 19 ki.
bujhe: bhai 12 barsha, didi 19 barsha.
didi bhai bhanda kati barsha jethi?
didi bhai bhanda 7 barsha jethi hunuhunchha.
malai momo man parchha tara pizza man pardaina.
momo ta dherai lai man parchha! jhol momo ki fry?
maile kun khana man pardaina bhane?
tapai lai pizza man pardaina bhannubhayo.
mero naam aayush ho.
namaste aayush! kasto chha?
thik chha. ma engineering padhchhu.
wah, engineering! kun branch?
computer. mero naam ra padhai bhana ta
tapai ko naam aayush ho ra tapai computer engineering padhnuhunchha.
mero sanga 3 ota biralo chhan: mimi, kalu ra tiger.
3 ota biralo! ghar ramailo hola.
kalu ali birami chha.
kalu chhito niko hos. pashu doctor lai dekhauna ramro hunchha.
mero biralo haru ko naam k k ho? ra birami ko?
tapai ko biralo haru mimi, kalu ra tiger hun. birami chai kalu chha.
bholi mero exam chha, ganit ko.
all the best! kun chapter ma dar lagchha?
algebra.
algebra ma equation ek ek step milaudai garnus, ani answer feri rakhera jaanchnus.
mero exam kun bisaya ko ho bhaneko thiye?
tapai ko bholi ganit ko exam chha, ra algebra ma ali dar lagchha bhannubhayo.
ma 25 barsha ko hu.
bujhe, tapai 25 barsha ko hunuhunchha.
5 barsha pachhi ma kati ko hunchhu?
5 barsha pachhi tapai 30 barsha ko hunuhunchha.
mero sathi ko naam rohan ho, u dharan ma baschha.
rohan dharan ma baschha, bujhe.
mero sathi kaha baschha?
tapai ko sathi rohan dharan ma baschha.
maile aaja 3 kilo aalu kine.
thik chha. tarkari banaune plan ho?
ani 2 kilo pyaj pani.
aalu ra pyaj, ramro combination.
jamma kati kilo kine?
tapai le jamma 5 kilo kinnubhayo: 3 kilo aalu ra 2 kilo pyaj.
mero favorite rang nilo ho.
nilo rang aakash jasto shanta lagchha.
ani mero bhai ko hariyo.
bujhe: tapai ko nilo, bhai ko hariyo.
bhai ko favorite rang k ho?
tapai ko bhai ko favorite rang hariyo ho.
I live in Lalitpur and I work as a designer.
Nice! Lalitpur has a lot of art and design history. What kind of design do you do?
Where do I work and what do I do?
You live in Lalitpur and you work as a designer. You didn't tell me the name of your workplace.
mero buwa ko naam krishna ho.
bujhe, tapai ko buwa ko naam krishna ho.
mero aama ko naam k ho?
tapai le aama ko naam bhannubhayeko chhaina, tyasaile malai thaha chhaina. buwa ko naam chai krishna bhannubhayo.
ma bihana 6 baje uthchhu ra 10 baje sutchhu.
ramro routine!
ma kati ghanta jagaa hunchhu?
tapai din ma 16 ghanta jagaa hunuhunchha.
messages.steps: 6 baje dekhi raati 10 baje (22 baje) samma: 22 - 6 = 16 ghanta.

messages.content: hamro ghar ma 5 jana chhaun.
5 jana ko pariwar, ramro.
didi bidesh gainu.
didi lai miss garnuhunchha hola.
aba ghar ma kati jana chhaun?
aba ghar ma 4 jana hunuhunchha.
mero phone ko password nabhana hai, tara mero naam bijay ho.
hunchha bijay. ma password jasto kura sodhdina ra rakhdina pani.
mero naam k ho?
tapai ko naam bijay ho.
ma sanibar football ra aaitabar guitar class jaanchhu.
hapta ko anta ramro bitchha jasto chha!
aaitabar ma k garchhu?
aaitabar tapai guitar class jaanuhunchha.
mero gaun ko naam sirubari ho, syangja ma parchha.
sirubari ta homestay ko lagi prasiddha gaun ho!
mero gaun kun jilla ma parchha?
tapai ko gaun sirubari syangja jilla ma parchha.
mero umer 16, sathi ko 18.
bujhe.
haina sathi ko 17 ho.
thik chha, sathi ko umer 17.
hami dubai ko jamma umer?
tapai dubai ko jamma umer 33 barsha ho.
malai chiya bhanda coffee man parchha.
coffee lovers! bihana ko coffee le energy dinchha.
ma k man paraunchhu, chiya ki coffee?
tapai lai chiya bhanda coffee man parchha.
ma nurse hu, bir hospital ma kaam garchhu.
dhanyabad, nurse haru ko kaam dherai mahatwapurna hunchha.
ma kun hospital ma kaam garchhu?
tapai bir hospital ma nurse ko kaam garnuhunchha.
